Description:
Verify incremental sync returns only modified records after an update is made in the backend

CRITICAL: Application must be running (not restarted) for background sync to use incremental mode.

Test Data:
- Stored timestamp from previous sync (TC-001)
- Modification: Update one item in Collection A (e.g., change title)
- Expected: Only the modified item returned in delta response
Precondition:
- Application has completed initial full sync (TC-001 completed)
- Application is currently RUNNING (not restarted)
- Timestamp stored for Collection A from previous sync
- One item modified in backend after last sync
Test Steps: Verify application is currently running (not restarted since TC-001)
Expected Result: Incremental sync returns only the modified record. Upsert logic applies changes without affecting unmodified records. Timestamp updated to new value.

Test Steps: Record current state of Collection A (count and sample records)
Expected Result: 50 items documented with current field values

Test Steps: Modify one item in Collection A via backend (e.g., change title)
Verify response contains only the modified item
Expected Result: isFullDataset: false with only 1 modified record in response

Test Steps: Inspect Collection A in local database
Expected Result: Modified record upserted with updated title. All other 49 items unchanged.

Test Steps: Verify timestamp updated after successful sync
Expected Result: New timestamp stored, replacing previous one. Chronological order maintained.
